definitions.observedCount: train records containing this nutrient label, including estimated labels
definitions.acceptedCount: non-estimated fixed values and valid declared ranges accepted for an auxiliary prior
definitions.declaredRange: range midpoint is used only as a prior representative, never represented as a fixed point value
definitions.independentFamily: normalized maker + productFamily group with at least one accepted label for this nutrient
definitions.familyWeight: each independent family has total weight 1 per nutrient; its records share that weight equally
definitions.maximumMakerShare: largest maker share of independent family total weights for this nutrient
definitions.maximumFamilyShare: largest independent family share of total family weights for this nutrient
definitions.effectiveFamilySampleSize: Kish ESS = (sum of family total weights)^2 / sum of squared family total weights, after record weights are aggregated within family
definitions.missingCount: train records without a usable label value or valid declared range
definitions.invalidExclusionReasons: counted label-level exclusions; malformed source structure or integrity failures reject the audit
definitions.makerFamilyCountsBySha256: maker identity is SHA-256 of normalized name; values count independent families
